Provenance.ContractNote: Aggregates (GrandTotals, GroupLevels) reflect the report's RecordSource query result set (executed via ACE OLE DB), not the rendered report's footer-control expressions. DisplayTotals separately captures the supported report-footer aggregate expressions (Sum over numeric result-set columns) — the number a human reads in the footer — evaluated over that same result set; un-derivable footer controls are recorded in Skipped. Parity comparisons must compare like-for-like.
